definitions.name: L1B.DELTAS
definitions.body: '[' '(' REPLACE ']' ')' REPLACE CHARS [ 'CH' BIND 1 -1 CH '(' EQ SELECT ] MAP

definitions.name: L1B.REDUCE
definitions.body: 'RS' BIND 1 6 RANGE RS [ 'IGN' BIND '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE ] FOLD
definitions.note: delete adjacent () and [] pairs six times; leaves the reduced String

definitions.name: L1B.BALANCED
definitions.note: bracket String to TRUE when fully balanced

definitions.name: L1B.BPREFIX
definitions.body: CHARS 'CV' BIND 0 CV LENGTH RANGE [ 'KK' BIND KK 0 CV KK TAKE JOIN L1B.BALANCED SELECT ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: length of longest balanced prefix of a bracket String

definitions.name: L1B.SJOIN
definitions.note: Vector of Strings joined with single spaces

definitions.name: L1B.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty word to first letter upper, rest lower

definitions.name: L1B.TOPW
definitions.body: TALLY 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: most frequent element of a Vector; ties go to the earliest first occurrence

definitions.name: L1B.NAMESUMS
definitions.body: 'EN' BIND EN [ 0 GET ] MAP EN [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'GR' BIND GR KEYS GR VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] to Record name -> sum, first-appearance order

definitions.name: L1B.DIFFS
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND RV RV 0 GET 1 COLLECT RV -1 DROP CONCAT SUB
definitions.note: each element minus the one before it (first becomes 0), same length

definitions.name: L1B.RUNIDS
definitions.body: L1B.DIFFS 'DD' BIND DD DD MUL 1 MIN 0 [ ADD ] SCAN
definitions.note: run index (0,1,2..) of each position of an integer Vector

definitions.name: L1B.RUNS
definitions.body: 'RW' BIND RW L1B.RUNIDS RW GROUP VALUES
definitions.note: integer Vector to Vector of its maximal runs, each a Vector

definitions.name: L1B.MAJ
definitions.body: 'MJ' BIND MJ TALLY 'MT' BIND MT KEYS 'MK' BIND MT VALUES 'MC' BIND MC -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET 'MI' BIND MK MI MK LENGTH MC MI GET 2 MUL MJ LENGTH GT SELECT GET
definitions.note: value in more than half the positions, else NIL

definitions.name: L1B.MISS
definitions.note: readings to 1 where missing (NIL), 0 where present

definitions.name: L1B.STARTS
definitions.body: 'MS' BIND MS 0 1 COLLECT MS -1 DROP CONCAT SUB 0 MAX
definitions.note: 0/1 Vector to 1 at the first position of each run of 1s

definitions.name: L1B.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MDV' BIND MDV LENGTH 'MLN' BIND MDV MLN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MDV MLN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty Vector of numbers

solutions.brackets.depth: L1B.DELTAS 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.ledger.top_name: L1B.NAMESUMS 'RC' BIND RC KEYS RC VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.ledger.debtors: L1B.NAMESUMS 'RC' BIND RC KEYS [ 'KY' BIND RC KY GET 0 LT ] FILTER
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'LG' BIND LG LG [ 1 GET ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ L1B.CAP ] MAP L1B.SJOIN
solutions.prose.longest: G0A.WORDS 'PW' BIND PW PW [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.runs.rle: L1B.RUNS [ 'GG' BIND GG 0 GET GG LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
solutions.runs.upruns: L1B.DIFFS 0 GT 1 [ 'FG' BIND 1 ADD 1 FG SELECT ] SCAN 1 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.filled: 'SV' BIND SV SV [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ 'EL' BIND EL EL NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: L1B.MISS 0 [ 'MX' BIND 1 ADD MX MUL ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'SR' BIND SR 1 DROP SR -1 DROP DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'SS' BIND SS SS [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER G0C.MAXV DIV
solutions.series.mad: 'SQ' BIND SQ SQ L1B.MEDIAN SUB 'AD' BIND AD AD -1 MUL MAX L1B.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'MV3' BIND MV3 -2 DROP MV3 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD MV3 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'RM' BIND RM RM 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
